nodes.body: This gate relies entirely on `assert`, but optimized Python (`python -O` or `PYTHONOPTIMIZE`) removes every assertion. In that mode a corrupted archive can reach the unconditional `PASS` output without validating counts, hashes, seals, or reconstruction results. Refuse optimized execution (or replace assertions with explicit checks) and update the delivery seal/anchor so the advertised integrity gate cannot report a false success.

VALID. Fixed in c5ee3d0: the advertised gate now refuses optimized Python before any assertion-dependent validation. Real CLI regressions cover -O, -OO and inherited PYTHONOPTIMIZE; each was RED before the fix and now exits nonzero without PASS. A deliberately corrupt manifest is rejected in all modes, while normal verification and restored relocated data pass.

The original12-file delivery/index20387a7b is preserved byte-for-byte as historical evidence. The corrected current tool has externally anchored indexdd63309f and also verifies that preserved snapshot. All original author/guidance/input/review seals remain unchanged. Full structural checks pass (root8/build10/layout1/grade12;46build/120review cases). Diff growth is1.774%, below the25% gate.
